method: PLAYBOOK + QUEUE + README ethos; research-cycle-1/2 store artifacts; open GitHub issues (only #162/#183 remain); recent origin/main commits through #346; felt-carto roadmap leftover phases; ecosystem-alignment Mergin/QFieldCloud sync pain; dashboards Phase 2 open filter widget; PostGIS help honesty vs shipped Phase 1.5 API; portal-web offline-download still full GeoJSON; drawings anonymous Phase 1.5 stubs; MCP OSM gap vs Overpass service

proposals.title: Wire field offline pull to layer delta?since=N
proposals.summary: Server delta sync and syncVersion shipped (#328) and help documents them, but portal-web offline-download still re-fetches full GeoJSON and offline-sync never stores or sends a cursor. Field crews on large layers pay O(n) on every refresh; Mergin/QFieldCloud peers already ship changeset sync. Persist syncVersion on the offline package and refresh via GET .../delta?since=N (full geojson only on first package or missing cursor).
proposals.rationale: Highest-leverage unfinished slice of the Mergin-shaped sync story already paid for on the API. Closes a Felt/Field Maps seat pain without a new pillar.
proposals.risk: Delta semantics must honor deletes and share geo/row scope the same as features; corrupt or missing cursors need a full-resync fallback so packages never silently diverge.
proposals.ethosFit: Hardens the field PWA on open PostGIS data the portal already owns. Beats seat-metered Field Maps sync cost without inventing a new collection product.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Store syncVersion on each offline layer package; on refresh call delta?since=N and apply upserts/deletes; if the server returns 410/unknown cursor or no version, fall back to full geojson once and reset the cursor; extend offline-sync specs.

proposals.title: Anonymous markup on public maps when allowAnonymousDrawings is on
proposals.summary: Drawings service already models anonymous authors and the map setting allowAnonymousDrawings exists, but create still requires a signed-in user. Completing BFF anon-author cookie minting, Public create when the flag is true, and a conservative per-IP rate limit finishes drawings Phase 1.5 without opening unauthenticated write by default.
proposals.rationale: Help claims viewers can redline shared maps; unsigned public visitors still cannot. Opt-in flag plus rate limits keep abuse bounded without a maintainer email/notification call.
proposals.risk: Public-map spam if a map editor enables the flag without rate limits. Ship with hard caps (sets per IP per hour, features per set) and no anonymous promote.
proposals.ethosFit: Felt-shaped stakeholder redline without forcing a portal account or Pro seat. Guided draw before GeoJSON paste; stays inside Web Maps.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Mint a stable anon-author cookie in the BFF; allow Public POST/PATCH for drawings only when allowAnonymousDrawings is true; enforce DRAWING_LIMITS + per-IP rate limit; surface the existing settings toggle in markup help; no anonymous promote.

proposals.title: Dashboard filter widget on the existing cross-filter context
proposals.summary: Dashboard Phase 2 cross-filter from chart clicks already ships. Research still calls out a dedicated filter widget (category, numeric range, date range) publishing into the same MapLayerFilter selection context. The wire format and aggregate ?where= path exist; the widget is the remaining 1-day slice.
proposals.rationale: Finishes the KPI/operations board filter story without a global cross-filter graph editor or a new item type.
proposals.risk: Widget UX can sprawl into a query builder. Keep attribute predicates only; one selection at a time; never persist; reuse MapLayerFilter + inspector visibility.
proposals.ethosFit: Guided dashboard filters before raw SQL. Dashboards stay web-app layouts, not a separate product.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add a filter widget that publishes category / numeric / date predicates into the existing per-page selection context; subscribe indicators, charts, and maps the same way chart clicks do; document in web-apps help + What's new.

proposals.title: Re-apply losing-side syncConflicts from the layer data panel
proposals.summary: Review UI lists capped syncConflicts (#339) but crews still cannot recover the losing edit without hand-copying attributes. Add a guided Re-apply action that PATCHes the losing-side geometry/properties onto the current feature (with baseObservationId) or opens a side-by-side draft for deletes.
proposals.rationale: Completes the honesty upgrade started by checkOnly + conflict artifacts. Esri Community threads show field crews lose work to silent last-write-wins.
proposals.risk: Blind re-apply can overwrite newer good edits. Require explicit confirm, show current vs losing side, and refuse when the feature id is gone unless the user chooses recreate.
proposals.ethosFit: Recoverable field UX on the operator's hardware. Guided recovery over silent discard.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: On SyncConflictsPanel, add Re-apply for update conflicts (PATCH with losingSide + current baseObservationId) and Recreate for deletes; dismiss or keep the artifact after success; help + What's new.

proposals.title: MCP query_osm tool over the existing Overpass path
proposals.summary: Roadmap MCP Phase 1 listed query_osm beside the read tools; portal-mcp still lacks it even though OsmService and save-as-data-layer exist. A thin read tool that runs a bounded Overpass/relational query and returns GeoJSON (optional follow-up write via create_data_layer_from_geojson) closes the gap.
proposals.rationale: Felt/CARTO MCP stays Enterprise-gated. Shipping OSM query in the open MCP keeps machine automation on self-hosted Overpass defaults.
proposals.risk: Public Overpass abuse / timeouts. Cap bbox area and result count; prefer org osmOverpassEndpoint when set; refuse huge queries with a plain-English error.
proposals.ethosFit: Open standards automation; OSM as first-class source. No per-seat MCP upsell.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add MCP tool query_osm that POSTs to the existing OSM query/resolve path with bbox + tag or relational args; return FeatureCollection; document rate/size limits in portal-mcp README.

proposals.title: Field push uses checkOnly before transferring edits
proposals.summary: API checkOnly on feature PATCH/DELETE already validates baseObservationId without writing (#329). offline-sync still posts full edits first and only learns about 409s after transfer. A cheap dry-run pass surfaces stale rows before bytes move, matching Mergin's check_only pattern.
proposals.rationale: Pairs with R3-field-delta-sync; can ship as the same PR or a thin follow-up. Improves field honesty without UI invention.
proposals.risk: Extra round-trips on huge queues. Batch checkOnly per layer and skip when baseObservationId is absent (create-only).
proposals.ethosFit: Field reliability on your hardware. Recoverable sync before silent overwrite.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Before applying a queued update/delete, call the same path with checkOnly=true; on 409 record the conflict artifact path and mark the edit rejected with the server reason; then proceed with real writes for the rest.

proposals.title: PostGIS help catch-up plus guided table picker on connect
proposals.summary: connecting-postgis.md still says SRID reprojection and visual WHERE are Phase 1.5 coming next, but the API already reprojects non-4326 and FilterEditor compiles MapLayer.filter. Meanwhile the connection wizard saves without a guided table preview. Refresh help for honesty and add a post-test table list (name, SRID, row estimate) so authors see what registered before Save.
proposals.rationale: Docs honesty is playbook-required; schema browser Phase 2 is the cheap UX bridge on an API that already inventories geometry tables.
proposals.risk: Large schemas can overwhelm the UI. Cap listed tables, show geometry tables only, and keep Save registering the same set the probe already uses.
proposals.ethosFit: Prefer PostGIS live-read over copying data into SaaS. Guided connection before raw connection strings.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Update connecting-postgis.md Limitations; extend test-connection (or a follow-up probe) to return table inventory; render a read-only table list in PostgisConnectionBuilder before Save.

proposals.title: Export a markup set as GeoJSON from the panel
proposals.summary: Roadmap success criteria for drawings include a direct GeoJSON export link. Promote already copies to a data_layer; a Download GeoJSON action on a set (author or map editor) is a one-afternoon honesty win for handoff to QGIS without promote.
proposals.rationale: Open formats out; reviewers should leave with standards-shaped files, not screenshots.
proposals.risk: Low. Cap feature count already enforced by DRAWING_LIMITS; no new write path.
proposals.ethosFit: Open file formats throughout. Guided export before asking users to scrape the network tab.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add GET .../drawings/:id.geojson (or client-side blob from the already-loaded set) plus a Download control on the markup panel; mention in markup help.

proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n readiness on remaining hard-coded chrome
proposals.summary: After terrain, chrome sweep (#346), and tile-layer errors (#348 in flight), keep extracting bounded hard-coded strings (form designer chrome, remaining map panels, service editor) into catalogs with t() calls. No Weblate, no RTL, no locale product choice.
proposals.rationale: Only two open issues; #162 remains the finishable cross-cutting slice playbook already prioritizes.
proposals.risk: Catalog churn across five locales. Keep the PR to one surface area; machine-translate non-en with the existing Phase 1.1 pattern.
proposals.ethosFit: Mechanical readiness for the self-hosted EU/LATAM demo audience. No localization SaaS decision.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Pick one bounded surface (form designer chrome or service editor) and extract strings into en/es/fr/de/pt-BR catalogs with t() calls.

proposals.title: Guided Buffer shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: DuckDB Analyze correctly refuses meter buffers without PROJ in WASM. Server-side buffer tool and derived-layer builder already exist. Add a one-click Buffer this layer control on the data-layer Analyze or layer page that opens a guided distance/unit form and creates a derived_layer buffer recipe instead of lying in the browser.
proposals.rationale: Wherever Esri meters buffer work, ship free on PostGIS. Guided parameters over raw recipe JSON.
proposals.risk: Users may expect instant in-browser results. Label clearly as a server derived layer job and link to analysis tier availability.
proposals.ethosFit: Free-at-point-of-use analysis on your hardware. Prefer PostGIS buffer over proprietary Spatial Analyst seats.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add Buffer action that POSTs a single-step buffer derived_layer from the current layer id with guided meters/feet distance; reuse existing worker path; help + What's new.
